title: Standard Operating Procedure: High-Speed Thermal Packaging Seal & Label QA Inspection
regulatory_references: FDA 21 CFR Part 110 (Current Good Manufacturing Practice)
GFSI Global Standard for Food Safety Issue 9
objective: Establish rigorous automated and visual quality inspection protocols to guarantee 100% seal hermeticity, eliminate foreign body contamination, and ensure zero allergen mislabeling at 450 units per minute.

inspection_points.name: Thermal Ultrasonic Seal Integrity
inspection_points.tolerances: Zero tolerance for leaks >= 50 microns. False reject threshold target < 0.25%.

inspection_points.name: Multi-Allergen Label Verification
inspection_points.tolerances: 100% optical character verification (OCV) match against SAP batch master.

operational_roles.current_mode: Manual periodic grab sampling (1 unit every 30 seconds)

operational_roles.escalation_path: Manual line shutdown if 3 consecutive defects observed within 60 seconds

transformation_opportunity: Deploying continuous edge-vision model on conveyor infeed automates 85% of visual sampling, freeing operators to supervise automated pneumatic reject divert loops and perform preventative system maintenance.
